for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    inp=G[n+' input']; out=np.array(G[n+' output'])
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cols={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[r][c] not in (0,5): cols.setdefault(inp[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    order=[k for k in sorted(cols.keys())]
    # sides: color with smaller min col = left
    def bbox(cells,col):
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        return np.array([[inp[r][c] for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)])
    D1=bbox(cols[order[0]],order[0]); D2=bbox(cols[order[1]],order[1])
    # original offsets within the input grid
    r1,c1=min(r for r,c in cols[order[0]]),min(c for r,c in cols[order[0]])
    r2,c2=min(r for r,c in cols[order[1]]),min(c for r,c in cols[order[1]])
    off=(r2-r1,c2-c1)
    # draw canvas = bbox of union region spanning both bboxes

    sub=A[min(rows):max(rows)+1,min(cols_):max(cols_)+1]
    print(n,'direct union crop:')
    print(sub.tolist(),'matches out:',np.array_equal(sub,out))
